scripts.zk:compile: mkdir -p build/aggregate && circom circuits/aggregate.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/aggregate -l circomlib/circuits && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > build/aggregate/aggregate_js/package.json
scripts.zk:ptau: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 build/aggregate/pot12_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute build/aggregate/pot12_0000.ptau build/aggregate/pot12_0001.ptau --name='first' -v && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/aggregate/pot12_0001.ptau build/aggregate/pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.zk:setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/aggregate/aggregate.r1cs build/aggregate/pot12_final.ptau build/aggregate/circuit_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute build/aggregate/circuit_0000.zkey build/aggregate/circuit_final.zkey --name='1st contributor' -v && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/aggregate/circuit_final.zkey build/aggregate/verification_key.json
scripts.zk:export-verifier: mkdir -p contracts/aggregate && snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/aggregate/circuit_final.zkey contracts/aggregate/verifier.sol && sed -i "s/contract Groth16Verifier/contract aggregateVerifier/" contracts/aggregate/verifier.sol
scripts.zk:compile-deploy: npx hardhat compile && npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/aggregateModule.ts --network sepolia --verify
scripts.zk:prep: npm run zk:compile && npm run zk:ptau && npm run zk:setup && npm run zk:export-verifier && npm run zk:compile-deploy
scripts.zk:input: tsx scripts/generate_input.ts aggregate rest/vp_demo.json $EXTRA_ARGS && node build/aggregate/aggregate_js/generate_witness.js build/aggregate/aggregate_js/aggregate.wasm build/aggregate/aggregate_js/input.json build/aggregate/witness.wtns
scripts.zk:prove: snarkjs groth16 prove build/aggregate/circuit_final.zkey build/aggregate/witness.wtns build/aggregate/proof.json build/aggregate/public.json && snarkjs groth16 verify build/aggregate/verification_key.json build/aggregate/public.json build/aggregate/proof.json
scripts.zk:full: npm run zk:prep && npm run zk:input && npm run zk:prove
scripts.zk:calldata: cd build/aggregate && snarkjs generatecall | sed '1s/^/[/; $s/$/]/' > calldata.json
scripts.payload: npx tsx scripts/payload.ts --vp rest/vp_demo.json --agg-proof build/aggregate/proof.json --agg-public build/aggregate/public.json
